title: Give cloud workers web search through the AI Gateway Web Search API
description: AI Gateway Web Search API (2026-10-02, https://blog.cloudflare.com/introducing-web-search-api/; partners Ceramic.ai, Exa, Linkup). Cloud workers (pi) could look up docs/error messages through our gateway route (no new credential in the container). Low priority: wire as an optional pi tool via the gateway, off by default, with a per-run budget.
acceptance_criteria: An opt-in pi tool in the worker image calls web search through the run's gateway token; off by default; tested with a fake gateway.
